styleSuffix: Painterly cinematic digital illustration with visible textured brushwork, deep-sea documentary mood, matte finish, rich detail, dramatic rim light from top-left, no text, no watermark. Isolated on a fully transparent background (PNG alpha): absolutely no backdrop, no gradient, no vignette, no fog, no ambient glow or halo outside the subject silhouette. The whole subject is visible with margin around it.

assets.prompt: A vintage 1930s brass bathysphere deep-sea diving capsule seen from the side, slightly three-quarter, spherical riveted brass hull with weathered patina and scratches, one large round porthole in the center facing the viewer. The porthole glass is a solid flat pure magenta disc (RGB 255, 0, 255), perfectly uniform, no reflections, no interior visible. A small external spotlight lamp mounted on the top-front, a tiny propeller at the back, a thick steel cable attached to a hook on top, some brass fittings and small gauges.
